mapper.select: SELECT request_id,status,attempts,replay_generation,generation_attempts,lease_token,lease_until,last_failure FROM asset_binding_release WHERE request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE asset_binding_release SET status='PENDING',replay_generation=replay_generation+1,generation_attempts=0, next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND status='DEAD' AND replay_generation=#{generation} AND replay_generation < 10 AND generation_attempts=10 AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL
